To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the design of a conformal radiation port for partial volume irradiation experiments in rats, using magnetic resonance imaging, was successful and the dose distributions were determined with high accuracy.
a protocol for partial‐volume irradiations of small volumes in small animals was designed and validated.
the designed set‐up allowed the study of differences of the radiation‐induced damage in small volumes, and that the dose in the shield area was 14% of that in the beam area.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a method for the accurate determination of absorbed doses in small volumes in experimental animal studies.
the study of the radiation response of the parotids in the rat.
the development of a set‐up that allows the study of differences of radiation damage to different parts of the same organ in the rat, in this case the parotid.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
this set‐up was a successful and reliable method to irradiate small volumes of rat parotids with 200 keV X‐rays.
the design of conformal partial‐volume radiation ports is a feasible method of studying the effect of partial‐volume irradiations in small animal studies.
this study has shown the possibility of performing high‐precision experiments with small animals.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have shown the possibility of performing partial volume irradiation in small animals with high accuracy.

we have demonstrated that the use of high resolution MRI and conformal radiation ports in combination with a dosimetry protocol can provide accurate three‐dimensional information of the dose distribution for small volumes.
it is possible to perform partial volume irradiation of small animals and that the dose distributions can be accurately measured and calculated.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the design of a conformal partial‐volume radiation port is feasible for small animals.
the use of conformal collimators for partial‐volume irradiations of small animals is possible and can provide a good approximation of the clinical situation.
it is important to know what dose is delivered to a specific volume of tissue in order to understand the biological effects.
